protocol.name: trindle_unlock_v1

description.summary: unlock the lock screen with the PIN

protocol.description: Offered only to the plugin Flow, from Trindle's own catalogue, through its own box socket. Any other program neither sees this global nor is answered if it somehow sends a request. The password cannot be given here: only the PIN, under the limits the lock screen puts on it.

interface.name: trindle_unlock_v1

description.summary: the one way Flow unlocks the screen

interface.description: The compositor checks the PIN itself and keeps count of wrong tries.

request.name: with_pin

description.summary: unlock the locked screen with the PIN

request.description: Answered by done or by refused.

event.name: refused

description.summary: the screen was not unlocked, and why

event.description: The reason is a few words, ready to show.
